## Assessing Quality

### FilterSeq on PCR Results

* `1_3_S1_L001_R1_001.fastq`
* `1_3_S1_L001_R2_001.fastq`

```{bash, echo = T, eval = F}
docker run -v /Users/emoseley/VHH/data:/data immcantation/suite:4.4.0 \
  FilterSeq.py quality -s /data/1_3_S1_L001_R1_001.fastq -q 20 --outname 1_3_S1_Barc_R1 --log /data/1_3_S1_Barc_R1_FS1.log


docker run -v /Users/emoseley/VHH/data:/data immcantation/suite:4.4.0 \
  FilterSeq.py quality -s /data/1_3_S1_L001_R2_001.fastq -q 20 --outname 1_3_S1_Barc_R2 --log /data/1_3_S1_Barc_R2_FS1.log
```

## Parse Logs for Read Quality

```{bash, echo = T, eval = F}
docker run -v /Users/emoseley/VHH/data:/data immcantation/suite:4.4.0 \
ParseLog.py -l /data/1_3_S1_Barc_R1_FS1.log /data/1_3_S1_Barc_R2_FS1.log -f ID QUALITY
```

### Load Data

```{r}
rone <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/1_3_S1_Barc_R1_FS1_table.tab", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')

rtwo <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/1_3_S1_Barc_R2_FS1_table.tab", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')
```

#### Summarize Quality Data

```{r}
summary(rone$QUALITY)
summary(rtwo$QUALITY)
boxplot(rone$QUALITY, rtwo$QUALITY, main = "Read 1 vs. Read 2 Quality Scores", names = c("Read 1", "Read 2"))
```

Note that the median observations for the `R2` file is below the quality threshold set in the `FilterSeq` module (Phred scores `< 20` are removed).
